name: ThemePicker

props.name: options
props.type: { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; preview: "light" | "dark" | "system" }[]

tagline: An illustrated radio group for the colour theme (gh#1439): each choice is a painted preview of the interface — light, dark, or the system split — over its glyph and label. Native radios in a fieldset (arrow keys move), the checked preview ringed in the primary tone. Geometry: `--editorial-theme-picker-*`.
usage: DO apply the theme at once; no Save button.
